_note: case-goals: `goalPrompt` is the question the case page's goals row asks while a case of this type has no goals (DqZaak Zaakplan: "nog geen doelen: wat wil de verzoeker dat er verandert?"). A case type without it shows no goals row. caseType moves to 1.45.0 so an existing instance re-imports the schema (renumber at merge if 1.45.0 is taken).

goalPrompt.title: Goal prompt
goalPrompt.description: The question the case page's goals row asks while a case has no goals, for example "What does the requester want to change?". Empty shows no goals row.
